page.layout: One printed page (right of the binding); running head at top with page number at top right; text in one column of verses; left edge shows fragments of the facing page's margin, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: nauerunt se ipsos sanctis in ministerium.
16 Vt & vos subiiciamini talibus, & omni cooperanti & laboranti.
17 Gaudeo autem de aduentu Stephanæ, & Fortunati & Achaici, quoniam vestri defectum hi suppleuerunt.
18 Refecerunt enim meum spiritum & vestrum, agnoscite igitur tales.
19 Salutant vos ecclesiæ Asiæ: salutant vos in domino multum Aquila & Priscilla cum ecclesia, quæ in domo eorum.
20 Salutant vos fratres omnes: salutate alij alios osculo sancto.
22 Si quis non amat dominum, sit anathema Maranatha.
24 Charitas mea cum omnibus vobis in Christo Iesu. Amen.

page.notes: Greek words in verses 17 and 19 (Ἀχαϊκοῦ, Ἀσίας) appear in the scan as rendered by the printer's Greek type; the Greek letters are not legible enough to copy reliably, so the Latin rendering is given as printed where possible. Several words in the left margin belong to the facing page and are omitted. Verse 22 "Maranatha" is as printed.
